notes.title: Chapter 3 Available - Find the EMP
notes.notes:
[h2]Story[/h2]
You will have to fight against the AI (Trinity) to access to the third Item (An EMP) in order to help Keanu to save the Listenbourg.


[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Order the drones to go to a specific location thanks to a control map
[*] Hive AI improved for the Player And Trinity (the enemy)
[*] Some Box are added in each level to help the player to handle Trinity agressivity at the start.
[/list]


[h2]Design[/h2]
Smoother highlighting items

 [list]

notes.title: Listenbourg is available now.
notes.notes:
This is the day! Listenbourg is available now as early access.

You can start the journey to save the Listenbourg and all the world.

At the same time i'm working on the next release.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Game will be release on Monday the 25 of September
notes.notes:
I'm exited to announce the first release. I hope you'll enjoy and give me a lot of feed back.
